title: Floating Fall
description: A floating fall is a body hanging in a slow drop: delayed gravity on hair and coat, still going down. The path remains toward the ground, even when the clock on the body is late.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Someone has left the roof. The coat opens late.
Hair hangs. The street is still far.
Use it for the beat after the push, when the drop should feel like a hymn and a disaster at once. It is the wrong tool for a hover, and for a real-time camera drop.
If there is no net descent, you shot levitation. If the whole frame is simply overcranked equally, you shot slow motion of a normal fall.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Keep downward travel. Delay gravity on hair, coat, and debris more than on the torso.
If the camera is locked, the body drifts down through a stable frame. If the camera also drops, the building or cliff should still parallax as falling-past.
A side-key keeps the body separate from the void. Name the height and what is already below.
Prompt a floating fall: a body hanging in slow drop, delayed gravity. For video, falls in slow, floating pieces, delayed gravity.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for the second after leaving the ledge, the dream of dropping, the stunt that should hang. Do not use it for a slapstick trip down stairs unless the joke is that time went soft.

blocks.text: Inception's hallway physics turns a fall into a drift through architecture. The Matrix rooftop and street drops hang bodies in delayed time.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousins are balloon Levitation and ordinary Slow Motion. The tell is a body that never descends, or a normal fall that is only slowed.
The fix is net downward travel, delayed cloth, and a readable ground.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is floating fall in film?
A floating fall is a drop with delayed gravity: the body hangs in a slow descent, hair and coat late, the ground still far. It is a fall, not a hover.
Floating fall vs levitation
Levitation stays up. A floating fall goes down with the clock wrong. One needs a gap under the feet that does not close. The other needs a ground that is coming.
When should I use floating fall?
Use it for the beat after the push, when a drop should hang. Skip it for a true hover, and for a real-time camera fall with rushing ground.
How do I prompt floating fall for AI image or video?
Write Floating fall of [Subject], a body hanging in slow drop, hair and coat in delayed gravity. Name height and ground. For video, slow floating pieces, path still down.
